newsitem.title: USA: Dow rallies in final minutes, NYSE sets curbs.
newsitem.headline: Dow rallies in final minutes, NYSE sets curbs.

text.p: U.S. blue chips resumed their late session climb, pushing the Dow Jones Industrial Average up more than 50 points and triggering index-arbitrage trading curbs on the New York Stock Exchange.
The Dow was up 65 points at 7788, putting blue chips within striking distance of their all-time high close of 7796.51, set on June 20. The NYSE imposed its program trading curbs at 1552 EDT/1952 GMT.
